instruction.text: Select the sentence that is a command.

b: They’re selling honey at the farmer’s market.
Do you want me to get honey for you?
I can’t wait to visit the market.
++Come back with three jars of honey.
I need permission to go on this school trip.
Can you sign this permission slip for me?
++Ask your parents to sign the permission slip.
I think the school trip will be so much fun.
Will you help me pack my suitcase?
There was so much to pack for the holiday.
++Help me pack my suitcase.
I wish someone would help me pack up.
We’ve looked for our cat all day long.
I hope we can find our cat soon.
++Come outside and look for the cat with me.
I asked my brother if he had seen our cat.
I’m nervous about going ice skating.
I’m not sure if I really want to go on the ice.
++Show me how to ice skate.
Will you hold onto me in case I slip over?
I forgot to tell my parents where we were waiting.
What should I tell my parents?
++Let your parents know that we’ll be waiting here.
You should give your parents a call.
We’re going outside to water the flowers.
My brother might know where the watering can is.
++Get the watering can from the shed for me.
You can water the roses if you want.
Daisy is going to do a speech in assembly.
I wonder if she is prepared for her speech.
++Daisy, practise your speech with me.
I know you’ll do a great job, Daisy.
